title: Relay.app alternatives, with checked prices | 50agents
description: Relay.app has shut down and deleted every workflow. Alternatives with approval steps: Zapier, Make, n8n, Activepieces and 50agents, with prices.
answer: Relay.app has shut down and permanently deleted all accounts, workflows and run history, so every Relay workflow has to be rebuilt somewhere else.

For a step that waits for a person, as Relay had, look at Zapier's Human in the Loop, Make's approvals in AI agents, n8n's approvals for tool calls, or 50agents, where outside sends wait for your yes.
lede: Relay users usually want the same mix: fixed workflows with AI steps inside, and a person approving at the steps that matter.

notice.body: Its homepage says it "shut down in September 2026" and that "All accounts, workflows, and run history have been permanently deleted." There is nothing to export.

entries.suits: Relay users who remember what their workflows did but not every step. Say it in plain words; any send outside waits in Needs you until a person approves it.
entries.limit: Approvals go to the people in your 50agents workspace, in the app; there are no email or Slack notifications for them yet.

entries.suits: Teams who want the biggest app catalog (10,541+) and an approval step that pauses a Zap for review.
entries.price: Free: 100 tasks a month. Professional: $19.99 a month billed yearly (750 tasks)
entries.limit: Human in the Loop is on Professional, Team and Enterprise only, not the free plan.

entries.suits: Teams who liked seeing the whole workflow. Make draws it on a canvas, and its AI agents can wait for a manual approval.
entries.price: Free: 1,000 credits a month. Core: from $9 a month (10,000 credits)
entries.limit: Approvals are described for AI agents; check that your scenario can pause where you need it before you rebuild.

entries.suits: Teams with a developer who want approvals on what an AI agent does, and runs on their own servers.
entries.price: No free cloud plan. Starter: €20 a month billed yearly (2.5K executions)
entries.limit: No free cloud plan, and the workflow is built node by node.

entries.suits: Small teams who want a free plan for up to 5 users, an open-source core, and the option to self-host.
entries.price: Free: 1,000 credits, up to 5 users. Plus: $20 a month flat (10,000 credits)
entries.limit: It lists 770+ apps, so check the ones your Relay workflows used.

us: You remember what your workflows did, not how they were wired, and would rather say it than rebuild it step by step.
Emails to customers should wait for a person's yes without you setting up an approval step.
Some workflows were really AI judgement, such as drafting replies, not fixed steps.
them: You need the biggest app catalog and a Zap that pauses for review: Zapier, with 10,541+ apps and Human in the Loop.
You want to see and edit every step on a canvas: Make.
You want runs on your own servers: n8n or Activepieces.

move.title: Rebuild your list from the edges
move.body: Look in the apps your workflows touched: sent mail, Slack messages a workflow posted, rows it used to add. Each one points to a workflow you had.

move.title: Write each as one sentence
move.body: For example "every new HubSpot contact is added as a row to my Google Sheet", and note where a person used to approve.

move.title: Rebuild the customer-facing ones first
move.body: Anything that emailed customers is what is now not happening. Start there, with the approval step in place.

move.title: Clean up old connections
move.body: Revoke Relay's access in Google, Slack and your other apps' connected-apps settings, and remove any webhook still pointing at Relay.

faqs.a: Yes. Its homepage says it has shut down and that all accounts, workflows and run history were permanently deleted.

faqs.q: Can I get my Relay workflows back?
faqs.a: Not from Relay. Its homepage says everything was permanently deleted. Rebuild from your own notes and from the traces in the apps your workflows used.

faqs.q: Which alternative is closest to Relay.app?
faqs.a: For fixed steps with a person approving at key points, Zapier with Human in the Loop or 50agents with Needs you. For AI agents with approvals, Make or n8n.
